description: Look up a Vancouver address, a street, a building's name or a resident's surname from 1945 or earlier in AddressLore's coverage. Returns the matching house's path for house_history; the candidates when the address could be on more than one street ("which street") or matches more than one old address; a street's houses a page at a time with its page; or says plainly that the address isn't covered (never a nearby house in its place), with the nearest covered streets and the coverage page.

page.description: Which page of a street's houses (40 a page) or of the buildings a word finds; 1 if left out.

query.description: An address ("526 Keefer Street"), a street ("Keefer Street") or a surname ("Clandenning").

name: find_house
title: Find a house
